questions.question: 34662. Absolute indication of splenectomy is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ঘ) Grade V spleen injury

Grade V spleen injury: Massive injury with shattered spleen — life-saving splenectomy.

Other Options:
ক) Lymphoma: Not absolute — only if symptomatic or diagnostic need.
খ) Thalassemia: Relative indication — if hypersplenism or transfusion-dependent.
গ) Leukemia: Again, not absolute.

questions.question: 34661. Primary blood buffer system is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: খ) Bicarbonate buffer

Bicarbonate buffer: Main buffer in plasma. HCO₃⁻ + H⁺ ↔ H₂CO₃ ↔ CO₂ + H₂O.

Other Options:
ক) Ammonia buffer: Important in renal tubules, not primary in blood.
গ) Phosphate buffer: Also renal, not primary in blood.
ঘ) Protein buffer: Contributes, but not the primary.

questions.question: 34660. ln Ectopic pregnancy
questions.option2: Isthmus of fallopian tube in the commonest site of ectopic implantation
questions.option3: incidence is more common among women taking oral contraceptives for long time
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ঘ) Abdominal pain preceded by amenorrhoea

Abdominal pain preceded by amenorrhoea: Classical triad — amenorrhoea → pain → bleeding.

Other Options:
ক) Bleeding precedes pain: Usually pain precedes or coincides with bleeding.
খ) Isthmus is the commonest site: Ampulla of fallopian tube is most common.
গ) More common among OCP users: OCPs reduce risk of ectopic.

questions.question: 34659. Feature of a malignant ulcer is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: গ) Everted edge

Everted edge: Typical of squamous cell carcinoma ulcers.

Other Options:
ক) Undermined edge: Seen in TB ulcers.
খ) Punched out edge: Common in trophic or gummatous syphilitic ulcers.
ঘ) Sloping edge: Found in healing ulcers.

questions.question: 34658. Causative Organism responsible for Cervical cancer
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: খ) HPV (Human Papilloma Virus)

HPV: Especially high-risk types 16 & 18 cause cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN).

Other Options:
ক) HSV: Not linked to cervical cancer.
গ) Chlamydia: Can cause PID but not cancer.
ঘ) Herpes zoster: Reactivation of varicella-zoster virus, not linked to cancer.

questions.question: 34657. The base of heart is formed mainly by
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ক) Left atrium

Left atrium: Lies posteriorly, forms base of heart (posterior surface).

Other Options:
খ) Left ventricle: Forms apex and part of diaphragmatic surface.
গ) Right atrium: Right border.
ঘ) Right ventricle: Forms anterior surface.

questions.question: 34656. Lining of urinary tract is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ঘ) Transitional epithelium

Transitional epithelium: Specialized to stretch — seen in renal pelvis, ureter, bladder.

Other Options:
ক) Ciliated columnar epithelium: Found in respiratory tract.
খ) Endothelium: Lines blood vessels.
গ) Mesothelium: Lines body cavities (pleura, peritoneum).

questions.question: 34655. Nerve responsible for sensation of smell is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ক) Olfactory

Olfactory: CN I — purely sensory, for smell.

Other Options:
খ) Trigeminal: Touch/pain/temp of face.
গ) Facial: Taste (anterior 2/3 tongue), not smell.
ঘ) Oculomotor: Eye movement, not sensory.

questions.question: 34654. Which of the following signs is characteristic for Stevens-Jhonson syndrome?
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ঘ) Nikolsky sign

Nikolsky sign: Skin sloughs off with slight rubbing — seen in SJS, TEN.

Other Options:
ক) Koebner phenomenon: Seen in psoriasis and lichen planus.
খ) Auspitz sign: Pinpoint bleeding in psoriasis.
গ) Dimple sign: Seen in dermatofibroma.

questions.question: 34653. Which of the following is not a typical presentation of pain in acute pancreatitis?
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: গ) Absent muscle guarding

Absent muscle guarding: Typically there is muscle guarding (peritonitis sign).

Other Options:
ক) Severe constant upper abdominal pain: Classical feature.
খ) Radiation to back: Common due to retroperitoneal location of pancreas.
ঘ) Rebound tenderness: Can occur due to peritoneal irritation.

questions.question: 34652. Oligo hydromnios is sever in
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ঘ) Renal agenesis of fetus

Renal agenesis: Kidneys produce urine, which is a major component of amniotic fluid. Without kidneys → severe oligohydramnios.

ক) Gestational diabetes: More often causes polyhydramnios.
খ) Anencephaly: Also associated with polyhydramnios.
গ) Nulliparous women: Parity doesn’t directly relate to amniotic fluid.

questions.question: 34651. The most common type of anaemia in pregnancy is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: গ) Iron deficiency anaemia

Iron deficiency anemia: Due to increased demand and dietary insufficiency in pregnancy.

Other Options:
ক) Thalassemia: Genetic and less common.
খ) Hereditary Spherocytosis: Rare inherited condition.
ঘ) Folic acid deficiency anaemia: Second most common, but not the top one.

questions.question: 34650. Indication of hospitalization of a burn patient is
questions.option1: 5% burn in the trunk of an adult patient
questions.option2: 10% burn in the trunk of a child
questions.option4: 10% Circumferential burn in the lower limb
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: গ) Inhalation burn

Inhalation burn: Serious complication, needs airway management, oxygenation, and ICU.



Other Options:
ক) 5% burn in the trunk of an adult: Minor burn — can be managed outpatient.
খ) 10% burn in the trunk of a child: Moderate — may need observation but not a strong indication.
ঘ) 10% circumferential burn in the lower limb: Important but not an immediate life threat unless it compromises circulation.

questions.question: 34649. Feature of atropinization is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: খ) Tachycardia

Tachycardia: Classic sign due to vagal inhibition.

Other Options:
ক) Mild dilated pupil: Atropine causes marked dilatation.
গ) Crepitation in lungs: Suggestive of pulmonary edema/infection, not atropine.
ঘ) Bronchorrhoea: Atropine reduces secretions, used to treat bronchorrhoea.

questions.question: 34648. Detection of hidden disease among apparently healthy population is done by
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ক) Screening

Screening: Early detection among asymptomatic people (e.g., breast cancer screening).

Other Options:
খ) Intervention: Comes after detection.
গ) Contact tracing: Related to infectious diseases, not general screening.
ঘ) Follow-up: For known cases, not for detection.

questions.question: 34647. Genital fistula can be prevented by
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ক) Improving essential obstetric care

Improving essential obstetric care: Prevents obstructed labor, the most common cause.

Other Options:
খ) Early operations of fibroid uterus: Not directly preventive.
গ) Treating PID cases: PID is not a major cause of genital fistula.
ঘ) Correcting maternal anemia: Important for general health, not directly for fistula.

questions.question: 34646. Late sign of death is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ক) Adipocere formation

Adipocere formation: Postmortem change occurring after days/weeks; sign of late decomposition.

Other Options:
খ) Cooling of body: Early sign (algor mortis).
গ) Dilatation of pupils: Early sign.
ঘ) Rigor mortis: Appears within hours.

questions.question: 34645. Carpal tunnel consists of
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ক) Median nerve
Median nerve: Passes through carpal tunnel and is compressed in carpal tunnel syndrome.



Other Options:
খ) Musculocutaneous nerve: Supplies anterior arm muscles.
গ) Radial nerve: Does not pass through carpal tunnel.
ঘ) Ulnar nerve: Passes through Guyon’s canal, not carpal tunnel.

questions.question: 34644. The largerst tributaries that drain into inferior Vena Cava is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: গ) Hepatic veins

Hepatic veins: Large vessels draining blood from liver directly into IVC.

Other Options:
ক) Left renal vein: Drains left kidney.
খ) Lumbar veins: Small tributaries.
ঘ) Right renal vein: Similar to left, but not the largest.

questions.question: 34643. The antigen presenting cell on skin is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: গ) Langerhan cells

Langerhan cells: Dendritic cells in the epidermis; present antigen to T-cells.

Other Options:
ক) Basal cells: Keratinocyte precursors.
খ) Keratinocytes: Structural role, not APCs.
ঘ) Melanocytes: Pigment-producing, not immune cells.

questions.question: 34642. Complication of Caesarean section is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ক) Postpartum Hemorrhage

Postpartum Hemorrhage: Common complication due to uterine atony or surgical trauma.

Other Options:
খ) Vaginal stenosis: Not related to C-section.
গ) Low platelet count: Not a direct complication.
ঘ) Injury to liver: Rare and usually only with very difficult upper-segment surgeries.

questions.question: 34641. Symptoms of mild shock is
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: ক) Rise of respiratory rate

Rise of respiratory rate: In mild (compensated) shock, the body attempts to maintain perfusion by increasing respiratory rate and heart rate.


Other Options:
খ) Fall of blood pressure: This is a sign of decompensated (moderate to severe) shock, not mild.
গ) Reduced Urinary output: Typically occurs in moderate to severe shock.
ঘ) Coma: Suggests severe cerebral hypoperfusion, a late and severe sign.

questions.question: 34640. Majority of body fluid remains in
questions.explain:
Correct Answer: খ) Intracellular fluid

Intracellular fluid: About 2/3 of total body water is inside cells.

Other Options:
ক) Blood: Only a small portion of extracellular fluid.
গ) Interstitial fluid: It’s part of extracellular fluid but less than intracellular.
ঘ) Lymph: Very small percentage.

questions.question: 34639. Uses of wrought metal alloy except
questions.explain:

1.Orthodontic wires
2 Prosthodontics clasps
3.RCT instruments like files & reamers
4.Steel bands& brackets for orthodontic & pedodontic use
5. Stainless steel crowns
6.Dental instruments

questions.question: 34637. Function of silver in amalgam restoration except
questions.explain:
Function of Silver in amalgam restoration :

1.Major elements 
2 Whitens the alloy
3. Decreases the creep
4.Increases the strength 
5.Increases the expansion on setting 
6 Increases tarnish resistance 

ref: Manappallil

questions.question: 34636. Preferable condenser for the amalgam restoration is
questions.explain:
In manual condensation of amalgam restoration, 
Usually small point, triangular or rectangular serrated condenser is preferable for the greater force to set the restoration in the cavity.[approximately 3 to 4pounds]

ref :Manappallil

questions.question: 34635. The orientation of attachment of sprue to the pattern is
questions.explain:
Requirement of sprue former/ sprue/spruing: Should be-

1.Round in section to reduced turbulence 

2. Smooth at the junctions 

3.Adequate thickness to counter contraction

4.Short in length for quick entry of molten metal

5.More in number for large pattern.

6.Orientation of attachment of sprue former to the pattern is at 45° to the proximal wall to prevent impact of molten metal on delicate areas of the mould.

ref: Rawshan Akhter

questions.question: 34634. Improper positioning of the wax pattern in casting leads to
questions.explain:
Proper positioning of wax pattern in the casting ring helps the gases to escape out quickly before the molten metal gets in.  Other wise porosity will occur.


Other defects :
 1.Casting size mismatch.
2. Distortion 
3.Surface roughness
4.Nodules
5.Fins
6 Porosity 
7.incomplete casting
8.Contaminated casting

.ref: Rawshan Akhter, Manappallil

questions.question: 34633. Most popular separating medium is
questions.explain:
Most commonly used separating medium is

2% aqueous sodium alginate. /cold mould seal

Other commonly used separating media are

Tin foil, starch,vaseline, cellulose acetate 

ref: Deepak

questions.question: 34632. Workable stage of acrylic resin materials
questions.explain:
Physical stage of acrylic resin Materials :

1. Wet sand stage
2. Sticky stage
3.Dough or gel  stage - Monomer diffuses into polymer and became smooth,homogenous, dough like mass. Resin can be mouled at this stage 

4.Rubbery stage.

5.Stiff stage

questions.question: 34631. Regarding alginate impression manipulation
questions.option3: Removes by a sudden jerky force
questions.explain:
Manipulation of Alginate impression material:

1. Done in plastic bowl & spatula
2. Power, water ratio: 1 measure water with 2 level scope of power

3.Rapid spatulation by swiping or stropping against the side of bowl or Vigorous figure -eight motion to remove air bubble 
4. Mixing time for normal alginate is 60 second or 1minute.

5. Perforated rim lock tray is preferred. 
6. Removed from the mouth by a sudden jerky force to avoid the distortion of the impression. 

ref: Manappallil

questions.question: 34630. Reversible elastic impression materials is
questions.explain: ref: A H S Rahman

questions.question: 34629. Minimal bone requirement in vertical  height  for endosteal implants?
questions.explain:
Classification of implant depend on design or placement :

1 Subperiosteal /epiosteal impant.
2.Intramucosal inserts 
3.Transosteal implant

4.Endosseous/endosteal implant- Most widely used.Implants are placed directly into the bone.Usually transect only one cortical plate.
Almost all implants placed today are end osseous implant.
A minimum of 8mm vertical,  5.25mm mediolateral, 6.5mm buccolingual bone is the minimal required bone for this type of implant. 

ref: Deepak

questions.question: 34628. Type of bones  provides excellent stability for the implant system?
questions.explain:
Classification of bone: 4types

1.Dense compact bone- Very dense, found ant. region of the mandible. Provides excellent stability to titanium implants and most of the other implant system. 

2.Porous compact bone
3.Coarse trabecular bone
4.Fine trabecular bone.

ref: Deepak

questions.question: 34626. Telescopic crown is used in
questions.explain:
Types of Abutment :
1.Healthy/ideal abutment - unrestored vital tooth in its normal position is considered as an ideal abutment. 

2.Cantilever abutment 
3. Pier abutment 

4.Tilted abutment -Tilted  mandibular third molars are the most commonly encountered tilted abutment in the fabrication of a fixed Prosthesis.

To overcome the disadvantage of tilted abutment, following methods are commonly used

a) Mesial reduction of third molar
b) Modified partial veneer crown 
c)Orthodontic Treatment 
d) Nonrigid connector
e) Telescopic crown---A second crown in a vertical direction is placed on the fabricated retainer with vertical slot over the tilted tooth so that it alters the contour of the crown. This second crown on retainer is called telescopic crown.

5. Extensively damaged abutment/Dowel crown

6.Implant abutment 

ref: Deepak

questions.question: 34625. Long-term use of PPIs may lead to:
questions.explain: Chronic PPI use can reduce stomach acid needed for B12 absorption.

questions.question: 34624. Indication of complete cast crown
questions.explain:
Indication of complete cast crown:

1.Extensive destruction from caries or trauma
2. Endodontically treated teeth
3 Existing restoration 
4.Need for maximum retention & strength 
5.Providing contours to receive a removable appliance
6.Other recon touring of axial surfaces
7.Correction of occlusal plane.

Contraindication:
1.Aesthetics 
2 Less than maximum retention necessary 



ref: Deepak

questions.question: 34623. Which of the following antibiotics is known to be teratogenic and should be avoided in pregnancy
questions.explain: Tetracycline can cause permanent discoloration of teeth and inhibit bone growth in the fetus.

questions.question: 34622. The term therapeutic index (TI) is best defined as
questions.option1: The time required for a drug to act
questions.option2: Ratio of toxic dose to effective dose
questions.explain: TI = TD50 / ED50. A higher TI indicates a safer drug.

questions.question: 34621. Which is not the  primary stress bearing area in lower jaw?
questions.explain:
Stress bearing area of the edentulous arches:

A.Upper Jaw:

1. Primary stress bearing area-
Hard palate, postero-lateral slopes of the residual alveolar ridge

2.Secondary stews bearing area-
Rugae, 
Maxillary tuberosity
Alveolar tubercle. 
Crest of residual alveolar ridge.


B.Lower Jaw: 

1. Primary stress bearing area-
Buccal self area

2.Secondary stress bearing area -

Residual alveolar ridge 

ref: Deepak,Manappallil

questions.question: 34620. Master impression in CD fabrication is taken by the concepts of
questions.explain:
In  CD fabrication, 
Custom made tray or special tray impression is most commonly used for final/master impression. During taking impression,area with relief wax is recorded as pressureless impression manner and area without relief wax is recorded under pressure. 
THIS concept of applying pressure on certain area and relieving the others is called "selective pressure impression making ".

ref: Deepak

questions.question: 34619. Shape of the postdam resembles
questions.explain:
After recording the posterior palatal seal, entire border of the potsdam resembles the shape of a Cupid's bow

ref: Deepak

questions.question: 34618. Most common reason to retake the impression :
questions.explain:
Causes of retaking the impression: 

1.Improper positioning of the impression tray- Most common reason to repeat the impression 

2.Large voids
3. Improper consistency of impression materials 
4.Too much or too little impression materials 
5.Inadequate scrapping of the border moulding materials. 
6.Movement of the tray during setting of the impression materials 

ref: Deepak

questions.question: 34617. Decreased vertical dimension causes
questions.explain:
Alteration of vertical dimension in CD fabrication 

Increased vertical dimension causes 

1. Increased trauma 
2.Increased lower facial height 
3.check biting 
4.Difficulty in swallowing and speech 
5.stretching of facial muscles 
6. Increased volume or cubical space of the oral cavity.
7.Pain &clicking in TMJ

Decreased vertical dimension causes 

1.Less trauma
2. Decreased lower facial height
3.Decreased volume or cubical space of the oral cavity 
4.Angular chelitis
5 loss of lip fullness
6.Loss of muscle tone(flaccid muscle)
7.Difficulty in swallowing 
8.Pain, clicking, discomfort of TMJ with headache & neuralgia 
9.Thinning of the vermilion borders of lip.

ref: Deepak

questions.question: 34616. Transseptal fibers connect:
questions.option2: Cementum of one tooth to cementum of adjacent tooth
questions.explain: Transseptal fibers span between the cementum of neighboring teeth, maintaining tooth alignment

questions.question: 34615. Which cranial nerve innervates the parotid gland for secretion?
questions.explain: The glossopharyngeal nerve provides parasympathetic innervation to the parotid via the otic ganglion.

questions.question: 34614. With age, the pulp undergoes
questions.option3: Reduction in size due to secondary dentin
questions.explain: Secondary dentin forms with age, reducing pulp chamber size.

questions.question: 34613. Which vitamin enhances the absorption of calcium in the gut
questions.explain: Vitamin D increases calcium absorption in the intestines.
